beng.title: Mobile application showing locations of popular movie scenes in Cracow and nearby areas
beng.description: A mobile application presenting movie scene locations in Cracow and nearby areas. The app combines an interactive map, visited-place collections, user profiles and a location-based game mode.

video.label: Full UX walkthrough · ~3 min
video.unsupported: Your browser does not support the video tag.

beng.deploymentNote: Live deployment requires Google Maps API billing, so a recorded demo is provided above instead of a hosted version.

geospatial.title: Geospatial data rendering
geospatial.description: The app needed to present movie markers, the user's live position and a 20-meter collection radius clearly on mobile screens without making the map difficult to read.

dataModeling.title: Data modeling
dataModeling.description: The data model connects movies, locations, user collections, game scores and leaderboard entries, so keeping relationships consistent and queries simple was a core part of the implementation.

performance.title: Performance on mobile
performance.description: Map, profile and gameplay screens had to stay responsive while working with location updates, media and game state, so the UI was kept lightweight and unnecessary updates were minimized.

loginPage.title: Login panel
loginPage.desc: The login screen offers three options: by login form via email and password, Google account or via Facebook account. User can easily switch between login and registration screens by clicking button below.

movieMarker.title: Map with movie markers
movieMarker.desc: The map lets users browse locations where movie scenes were filmed. Users can see their position and track it in real time. They can also add movie locations to their collection after moving within 20 meters of a target, selecting the marker and choosing the collection action.

moviePage.title: Movie info screen
moviePage.desc: The main element of the page is a photo showing the location where a movie scene was filmed. The photo includes additional information about average critics rating, the movie genre and the year of production. The lower section contains detailed information, such as title, director's full name, the screenwriters and the cast.

profilePage.title: User profile
profilePage.desc: The user profile contains information such as email address, number of visited places, ranking score and games won. Below it, the user can browse collected movies, with each link opening detailed information about the selected title.

gamePage.title: Create or join game
gamePage.desc: The main screen is used to create or join a field game. It contains two actions: starting a game as the host by creating a room, or joining an existing session by entering a room code.

gameSet.title: Game start
gameSet.desc: Once the game begins, a timer appears at the top of the screen for both users and shows how much time is left to complete the task. Each player has a dedicated location marker, which tracks their current position on the map.

quizPage.title: Post game quiz
quizPage.desc: After a user reaches all locations visible on the map, the final quiz stage becomes available. The game continues until one player answers all questions correctly or the time runs out. The result is converted into a game score and added to the leaderboard.

leaderboardPage.title: Leaderboard
leaderboardPage.desc: The ranking displays a full list of registered users and their positions. It also includes the same information as the main section of the user profile, such as user email and summary game score.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: The settings screen lets users change their password, delete their account or submit a contact form. The available options are listed in one view, while the button in the upper-right corner signs the user out.
